decisions.title: UI Framework
decisions.summary: React is chosen as the UI framework for building the application.

decisions.title: Routing
decisions.summary: The project uses BrowserRouter for navigation between pages.

decisions.title: State Management
decisions.summary: Cart state is managed using Context, with CartProvider as the provider component.

decisions.title: Data Storage
decisions.summary: Product data is stored in a static JavaScript file, and cart data is persisted in localStorage.

decisions.title: Tailwind CSS
decisions.summary: Tailwind, a Utility-First CSS library, is chosen for styling, offering class composition directly in HTML.

decisions.title: Rubik Font
decisions.summary: The Rubik font is selected as the default, supporting Hebrew and providing a consistent look.

decisions.title: React Router 6
decisions.summary: React Router 6 נבחר כספרייה לניווט, עם שימוש ב-BrowserRouter לעטיפת האפליקציה.

decisions.title: React NavLink
decisions.summary: NavLink component is used for navigation links, automatically marking the active link.

decisions.title: React Context for Cart
decisions.summary: The cart state is managed using React Context, with a global Context updated by the 'add' function.

decisions.title: Gradient Background
decisions.summary: The home page's hero section uses a gradient background with CSS classes `bg-gradient-to-l from-brand-600 to-brand-500`.

decisions.title: React Keys
decisions.summary: React requires unique keys for efficient list rendering, as demonstrated in the `ProductCard` mapping.

decisions.title: useMemo for Filtering
decisions.summary: The `useMemo` hook is used to optimize filtering and sorting logic in the product catalog, recomputing only when dependencies change.

decisions.title: Copy Array Before Sorting
decisions.summary: Using `[...list].sort(...)` instead of `list.sort(...)` to avoid modifying the original array when sorting products.

decisions.title: Local State for Checkout
decisions.summary: The `checkedOut` state is kept locally in the `Cart` component as it's page-specific, not using a global context.

decisions.title: Data Format
decisions.summary: הנתונים מוגדרים כקבצי JavaScript סטטיים, ללא שרת או API.

decisions.title: Image Optimization
decisions.summary: שימוש בפרמטר `?w=600` ב-Unsplash URLs כדי לקבל תמונות ברוחב 600px, חוסך רוחב פס.

decisions.title: Lazy Loading
decisions.summary: הוספת `loading="lazy"` לתמונות מחוץ למסך, לטעינה רק בעת גלילה אליהן.

decisions.title: React Context
decisions.summary: React Context נבחר כדי לספק את ה-state של סל הקניות, המאפשר גישה אליו מכל רכיב.

decisions.title: useReducer
decisions.summary: useReducer נבחר על פני useState לניהול ה-state של סל הקניות, בזכות ארגון לוגיקת ה-actions וקלות הבדיקה.

decisions.title: שמירת state ב-localStorage
decisions.summary: ה-state של סל הקניות נשמר ב-localStorage, מאפשר המשכיות בין ביקורים.

decisions.title: React Form State
decisions.summary: הטופס מנוהל באמצעות React state, עם שימוש ב-controlled inputs.

decisions.title: Generic Handler
decisions.summary: שימוש ב-handler אחד, `handleChange`, עבור כל השדות באמצעות computed property.

decisions.title: Validation Function
decisions.summary: פונקציית `validate` בודקת את השדות לפי חוקי הוולידציה.

decisions.title: Submit Handler
decisions.summary: פונקציית `handleSubmit` מונעת submit מסורתי, מבצעת ולידציה, ומעדכנת את ה-state בהתאם.

decisions.title: Internal Component
decisions.summary: יצירת רכיב `Field` פנימי לשימוש חוזר עבור שדות הטופס.

decisions.title: Routing Library
decisions.summary: Chose React Router for client-side routing.

decisions.title: Global State Management
decisions.summary: React Context is used for global cart state with CartProvider.

decisions.title: NavLink
decisions.summary: משתמש ב-NavLink כדי להדגיש קישורים פעילים.

decisions.title: useCart
decisions.summary: משתמש ב-useCart כדי לגשת למספר הפריטים בעגלה.

decisions.title: Sticky Navbar
decisions.summary: הניווט העליון נשאר במקום בעת גלילה.

decisions.title: Cart State Management
decisions.summary: Use React Context and useReducer for global cart state without Redux.

decisions.title: State Management
decisions.summary: Use React's useState hook to manage form state and validation errors.

decisions.title: Validation Logic
decisions.summary: Implement a custom validation function to check form fields, using regular expressions for email and message fields.

decisions.title: React Router v6.26
decisions.summary: The project uses React Router v6.26 for routing.

decisions.title: BrowserRouter Setup
decisions.summary: The BrowserRouter component is used in main.jsx to enable routing hooks for all components.

decisions.title: useMemo for Filtering
decisions.summary: Use useMemo to optimize filtering of products, re-rendering only when dependencies change.

decisions.title: Lazy Loading Images
decisions.summary: Implement lazy loading for images to improve performance by loading only when visible.

decisions.title: line-clamp for Text
decisions.summary: Use line-clamp CSS property to truncate product descriptions after 2 lines.

decisions.title: Redux DevTools Logger
decisions.summary: For Redux devtools behavior, add a logger to the reducer function.

decisions.title: React Developer Tools
decisions.summary: Install React Developer Tools for Chrome/Firefox to inspect state, hooks, and re-renders.

decisions.title: Immutability in State
decisions.summary: Ensure state immutability by creating new arrays instead of modifying directly.

decisions.title: Computed Values
decisions.summary: Compute values like count from items instead of storing in state.

decisions.title: Custom Tailwind Colors
decisions.summary: Modify tailwind.config.js to add custom brand colors.

decisions.title: Group Hover Effect
decisions.summary: Use group and group-hover classes for hover effects on product cards.

decisions.title: RTL Support in Tailwind
decisions.summary: Tailwind supports RTL with text-right and margin classes that auto-flip.

decisions.title: Multiple Field Search
decisions.summary: Search in multiple fields (name, nameEn, description) for Hebrew and English text.

decisions.title: Locale-Aware Sorting
decisions.summary: Use localeCompare for sorting product names with Hebrew collation.

decisions.title: Versioning localStorage
decisions.summary: Version localStorage keys to handle schema changes.

decisions.title: aria-label for Buttons
decisions.summary: Use aria-label for accessibility, especially on buttons with short text.

decisions.title: alt Text for Images
decisions.summary: Always provide alt text for images, used in most img tags.

decisions.title: Build and Preview
decisions.summary: Build and preview locally before deploying with npm run build and npm run preview.

decisions.title: Environment Variables
decisions.summary: Create .env.local for environment-specific variables, accessed via import.meta.env.

rules.rule: Use RTL for all Hebrew text.
rules.notes: Ensure the `dir` attribute is set to `rtl` in the `<html>` tag.

rules.rule: Start with Mobile-First approach for responsive design.
rules.notes: Begin with `grid-cols-1` and adjust for larger screens using breakpoints.

rules.rule: Define brand colors as tokens in `tailwind.config.js`.
rules.notes: Use the format `brand.50-700` for brand color tokens.

rules.rule: Create component-specific classes in the CSS layer.
rules.notes: Examples: `.btn-primary`, `.btn-ghost`, `.card`.

rules.rule: הגדר את תגית 'lang' כ-'he' ואת תגית 'dir' כ-'rtl' בקובץ HTML הראשי.
rules.notes: זה מבטיח שהאתר יוצג כראוי מימין לשמאל.

rules.rule: Tailwind configuration should specify content paths and custom theme extensions.
rules.notes: This ensures Tailwind only processes used classes and applies custom brand colors/fonts.

rules.rule: Import font before @tailwind directives in CSS files.
rules.notes: Prevents build warnings.

rules.rule: Use `@layer components` to create custom classes that can be overridden by Tailwind utilities.
Use `.btn-primary`, `.btn-ghost`, and `.card` classes for specific UI components.
Use Tailwind's standard breakpoints for responsive design.
rules.notes: Prefixes like `sm:`, `md:`, etc. control layout based on device width.

rules.rule: Set `dir="rtl"` on the `<html>` tag for automatic RTL support.
rules.notes: Tailwind will automatically adjust margins and directions for right-to-left languages.

rules.rule: כל תיקייה אחראית על משהו אחד.
rules.notes: למשל, 'src/components' מכילה קומפוננטות משותפות, 'src/pages' מכילה עמודים שלמים, וכו'.

rules.rule: קומפוננטות: PascalCase
Hooks: camelCase עם prefix 'use'
קבצי data: camelCase
תיקיות: lowercase
ב-Vite, יש לכתוב את סיומת הקובץ המלאה ב-imports.
rules.notes: למשל, 'import ProductCard from '../components/ProductCard.jsx''.

rules.rule: השתמש ב-`<Link>` במקום `<a href>` לניווט בצד הלקוח ללא טעינה מחדש.
rules.notes: זה שומר על ה-state של האפליקציה.

rules.rule: עבור פרמטרים דינמיים ב-URL, השתמש ב-`useParams()`.
rules.notes: זכור שהפונקציה מחזירה תמיד מחרוזת, והמר למספר אם צריך.

rules.rule: Use 'end' prop in NavLink for homepage only
rules.notes: Ensures the homepage is only marked as active at the root URL, not sub-paths.

rules.rule: Use custom classes for product card zoom effect
rules.notes: Apply 'group' class to the product card and 'group-hover:scale-105' to the image for zoom on hover.

rules.rule: Use `key={p.id}` when mapping over lists in React to ensure efficient updates.
rules.notes: This is essential for React's reconciliation process.

rules.rule: Always copy arrays before sorting to avoid modifying the original data.
rules.notes: This is a general best practice to ensure data integrity.

rules.rule: שימוש ב-`Set` כדי להבטיח קטגוריות ייחודיות ב-`getCategories()`
rules.notes: מבטיח שלא יהיו כפילויות ברשימת הקטגוריות.

rules.rule: המרה של `id` ל-`Number` ב-`getProductById()`
rules.notes: נדרש כי `useParams()` מחזיר מחרוזת.

rules.rule: זריקת שגיאה ב-useCart
rules.notes: אם useCart() משמש מחוץ ל-CartProvider, יש לזרוק שגיאה ברורה במקום להחזיר undefined.

rules.rule: השתמש ב-controlled inputs ב-React כדי לנהל את ערכי השדות.
rules.notes: מאפשר עיבוד, הגבלה, או שינוי של הקלט בזמן אמת.

rules.rule: השתמש ב-computed property כדי ליצור handler גנרי עבור מספר שדות.
rules.notes: מאפשר שימוש ב-handler אחד עבור מספר שדות עם שמות דינמיים.

rules.rule: בצע ולידציה של השדות לפני שליחת הטופס.
rules.notes: מבטיח שהנתונים תקפים לפני ביצוע פעולה כלשהי.

rules.rule: השתמש ב-`e.preventDefault()` כדי למנוע submit מסורתי של הטופס.
rules.notes: מאפשר שליטה מלאה על התנהגות הטופס.

rules.rule: הצג הודעות שגיאה באופן ויזואלי ליד השדות הרלוונטיים.
rules.notes: מספק משוב מיידי למשתמש.

rules.rule: Use 'Rubik' font for Hebrew-friendly text rendering.
rules.notes: This font supports both English and Hebrew characters.

rules.rule: Set text direction to 'text-right' for RTL languages.
rules.notes: This is an automatic setting in CSS.

rules.rule: Use logical margin/padding properties like 'start' and 'end' for RTL support.
Use Hebrew text for error messages.
rules.notes: Ensure error messages are in Hebrew for a localized user experience.

rules.rule: Use specific CSS classes for form elements.
rules.notes: Apply consistent styling to form inputs, labels, and error messages.

rules.rule: Use `<Link>` or `<NavLink>` for navigation to avoid page refresh.
rules.notes: This is a best practice to ensure smooth navigation without disrupting the user experience.

rules.rule: Use `useNavigate()` hook for programmatic navigation.
rules.notes: This provides a more controlled way to navigate between routes.

rules.rule: Use useMemo for filtering to avoid unnecessary re-renders.
rules.notes: This ensures that the filter operation is only performed when dependencies change.

rules.rule: Always use lazy loading for images to improve page load times.
rules.notes: This ensures images are loaded only when they become visible in the viewport.

rules.rule: Truncate long text with line-clamp CSS property.
rules.notes: This provides a clean way to show a limited amount of text with an ellipsis.

rules.rule: Install React Developer Tools for state inspection.
rules.notes: This is a useful tool to understand component behavior and state changes.

rules.rule: Always create new arrays for state, never modify directly.
rules.notes: This ensures immutability and avoids unexpected side effects.

rules.rule: Compute values from state instead of storing them directly.
rules.notes: This reduces state complexity and makes updates more efficient.

rules.rule: Customize Tailwind colors in tailwind.config.js.
rules.notes: This allows for brand-specific colors and design.

rules.rule: Use group and group-hover classes for interactive hover effects.
rules.notes: This provides a clean way to add hover animations to groups of elements.

rules.rule: Tailwind supports RTL with text-right and margin classes.
rules.notes: This ensures proper text direction and margin behavior for RTL languages.

rules.rule: Search in multiple fields for Hebrew and English text.
rules.notes: This ensures comprehensive search results across different languages.

rules.rule: Use localeCompare for sorting with Hebrew collation.
rules.notes: This ensures correct sorting order for Hebrew text.

rules.rule: Version localStorage keys to handle schema changes.
rules.notes: This ensures data integrity and compatibility across different versions.

rules.rule: Always provide aria-label for accessibility, especially on buttons.
rules.notes: This ensures screen readers can convey the button's purpose.

rules.rule: Always provide alt text for images.
rules.notes: This ensures users with visual impairments understand the image content.

rules.rule: Build and preview locally before deploying.
rules.notes: This ensures the build is correct and avoids potential issues on the live site.

rules.rule: Use .env.local for environment-specific variables.
rules.notes: This ensures sensitive data is not committed to version control.

warnings.message: אל תשתמש ב-`<a href>` בניווט, זה יגרום לטעינה מחדש של הדף.
Ensure that the `useParams` hook is used correctly to extract dynamic route parameters, as shown in `ProductDetail.jsx`.
Be cautious when managing state locally within components. In more complex scenarios, consider using a state management solution like React Context or Redux.
ה-regex לאימייל הוא פשוט ולא מכסה את כל המקרים. שליחת אימייל אמת לאישור היא דרך בטוחה יותר ב-Production.
ARIA attributes לא הוספו לרכיבים, מה שעלול להשפיע על נגישות.
Avoid using `window.location.href` for navigation as it refreshes the page.
If cart data is not saving, clear localStorage and unload the page.
Check image URLs, CORS issues, and the Network tab in devtools if images are not loading.
If Tailwind styling is not working, check content path, dev server status, and try restarting.
